title: The key outlasted the warning
body: The radio log is clipped to a route sheet. Its last line says return key, while the key tag says the warning was never acknowledged. Someone has drawn a sun over the signature box.
rival_reading: A survey or farm service could return its key without signing a routine warning; a missing acknowledgement does not prove officials mishandled containment.
gloss: A returned route key is paired with a warning that has no acknowledgement.

title: A field note in the broadcast log
body: The notebook records a wet field and a sharp smell before the bulletin changed. The bottle is labelled for the route crew, but its cap is still sealed. A grease pencil has circled the old frequency.
rival_reading: A response crew could report field conditions before a revised broadcast and keep a sealed bottle for later; the sequence does not establish a program malfunction.
gloss: An observation of field conditions predates a broadcast change while the crew’s bottle remains unused.
